name: Clay Shooting Simulator VR
summary:
Clay Shooting Simulator VR is a skill-based VR sports simulator for Meta Quest, designed around precision, timing, and accuracy-focused target challenges. Track fast-moving clay targets, improve hand eye coordination, and develop reflex-based skills through structured practice and score-driven progression.
